method: Sequential reading of every assigned segment, including transitions/interviews/music. Names checked against official event67176 and card catalog. No full video replay reviewed.

games.summary: Yadon survives the early pressure and wins with Striking Illuminance and Lightweaver’s Assault.

beats.text: Singed Emotions delays Yadon’s level-up while RubyXillia builds toward Suzaku.
Vanish from Sight buys Yadon time to reach level 3 despite repeated burn damage.
With Infernal Vessel blocking his recovery, Yadon finds Uncover the Plot and finishes with Striking Illuminance into Lightweaver’s Assault.

games.summary: RubyXillia disrupts Yadon’s resources and burns through Vanish from Sight to equalize.

beats.text: Embercrypt Burn removes Incapacitate from Yadon’s graveyard before Zander can return it.
Impact Hammer and Blazing Throw unlock Suzaku, pushing Yadon into burn range.
Yadon uses Vanish from Sight, but RubyXillia draws Cinder Geyser for the finishing damage.

games.summary: RubyXillia keeps Yadon off his level-up plan, then closes with Suzaku and Vermilion Decree.

beats.text: Embercrypt Burn removes Incapacitate again, and Singed Emotions pressures Yadon into another Backup Charger.
Enfeebling Orb reduces Yadon’s available responses as RubyXillia reaches seven quest counters.
Suzaku’s Command and Peppered Chef force Resolute Stand; Vermilion Decree supplies the last damage.

games.summary: PokerKT survives Noel’s early pressure and equalizes with fast-speed damage.

beats.text: Convergent Beam removes Noel’s Frostsworn Paladin despite Viridian Protective Trinket.
Noel negates Zhang Jiao with Glimmering Refusal, keeping the Fractal mirror balanced.
PokerKT removes Safeguard Amulet, then chains Refracting Missile and Shimmering Refraction to force game 3.

games.summary: PokerKT survives Noel’s large Fractal board and wins the final exchange of damage and negates.

beats.text: Convergent Beam answers Noel’s Frostsworn Paladin again, stopping her early ally pressure.
Two Zhang Jiao plays build PokerKT’s resources while Noel struggles to find more damage.
PokerKT removes Viridian Protective Trinket and uses consecutive Glimmering Refusals to stop Noel’s lethal Refracting Missile.
Shimmering Refraction sets up PokerKT’s next-turn Refracting Missile, securing the final spot.

games.summary: RubyXillia slows PokerKT’s resources and converts Suzaku into the first-game win.

beats.text: After PokerKT sacrifices his own Censer of Restful Peace, RubyXillia brings out another to keep floating memory locked.
PokerKT uses Glimmering Refusal to stop Avatar of Suzaku, then Zhang Jiao restores life.
Portentous Tanggu and Fabled Ruby Fatestone complete Suzaku’s quest; Suzaku’s Command and Peppered Chef close the game.

games.summary: PokerKT stops a lethal Avatar attack and wins through RubyXillia’s recovery.

beats.text: Fiery Interference denies Zhang Jiao’s recovery and brings RubyXillia closer to Suzaku.
Crystalline Mirror removes Viridian Protective Trinket, allowing Aenean Frozen Shunt to stop Avatar of Suzaku’s attack.
After forcing Safeguard Amulet, PokerKT fires more damage and uses Frostbind from memory to stop Restorative Flame.

games.summary: PokerKT’s Nullifying Lantern and timed burn spells decide the championship.

beats.text: Convergent Beam targets Avatar of Suzaku; RubyXillia gives up the ally for quest counters instead.
Zhang Jiao draws two cards for PokerKT, giving him more resources for the final exchanges.
Nullifying Lantern shuts off RubyXillia’s fire graveyard synergies before PokerKT starts firing damage.

PokerKT stacks Refracting Missile and Shimmering Refraction before Safeguard Amulet resolves. RubyXillia answers with Shatter the Brittle and Restorative Flame, but Glimmering Refusal seals the title.
